import os,sys,json,hashlib,stat,datetime,pathlib
assert os.environ.get("SLURM_JOB_ID")=="6783003" and os.environ.get("SLURM_STEP_ID","").isdigit()
record_path=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); record_bytes=record_path.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(record_bytes).hexdigest()=="bacba88c05986571f8f7f6322a47f11cf0d18b5982382dc8596e86c34ee909f6"
record=json.loads(record_bytes); path=pathlib.Path(record["path"])
assert path.is_absolute() and path.resolve(strict=True)==path
fd=os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW); started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
try:
 before=os.fstat(fd); assert stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_size==58059912 and before.st_mode&0o111
 digest=hashlib.sha256(); count=0
 while True:
  block=os.read(fd,1024*1024)
  if not block:break
  count+=len(block);digest.update(block)
 after=os.fstat(fd); current=path.stat()
 keys=("st_dev","st_ino","st_size","st_mtime_ns","st_ctime_ns","st_uid","st_mode")
 assert all(getattr(before,k)==getattr(after,k)==getattr(current,k) for k in keys)
 assert count==before.st_size and digest.hexdigest()==record["sha256"],"the pinned Nsight executable bytes changed"
finally:os.close(fd)
print(json.dumps({"kind":"actual_nsight_executable_stream_hash_before_diagnostic_preparation","passed":True,"started_at_utc":started,"finished_at_utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"job_id":os.environ["SLURM_JOB_ID"],"step_id":os.environ["SLURM_STEP_ID"],"hostname":os.uname().nodename,"pid":os.getpid(),"tool_record":{"path":str(record_path),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(record_bytes).hexdigest()},"executable":{"path":str(path),"sha256":digest.hexdigest(),"bytes":count,"device":before.st_dev,"inode":before.st_ino,"uid":before.st_uid,"mode":oct(stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode))},"block_bytes":1024*1024,"tool_execution_count":0,"library_or_device_operations":0,"scientific_credit":0}))
